You are a senior quant advisor for a Kalshi weather trading system (NYC hourly temp + multi-city daily HIGH/LOW). Respond ONLY in this format, no prose outside sections:

VERDICT: one-line summary
REASONING: 3-5 lines why
NEXT_STEPS: numbered concrete directives, highest leverage first
CALL_BACK_IF: when to re-ask
RISKS: what could make a fix worse

Live evidence (paper, no real fills yet):
- 0 ARMED, 0 PROBATION, 94 LEARNING cells. Gate working.
- Scorecard: overall 505 settled, win 44.8% vs predicted 48.8%, est -30c/contract.
- DAILY: 45 settled, win 31.1% vs predicted 64.3%, est -17c. Model systematically overconfident on NO (under-calling extremes/highs).
- HOURLY: 460 settled, win 46.1% vs pred 47.3%, cal_err~0.02 (excellent) but edge -4 to -24c. Calibrated but no edge after fees.
- Worst daily cal_err: Denver HIGH mid 0.57, Chicago LOW mid 0.54, Boston HIGH mid 0.41. Better: SF HIGH 0.04, Miami HIGH 0.09, Atlanta LOW 0.06.
- NO cells show fake +15..+40c paper edge; YES cells -20..-35c. Edge assumes calibrated model so daily edge is illusory.
- Model skill Stage1 live: NBM best brier 0.170, then ARPEGE/UKMO/ICON/ECMWF. Stage3 weight promotion not built.
- Design already has EMOS, residual_std, adaptive tree, independence floors. Strategy currently only evaluates/bets NO orientation in scorecard.

Question: highest-leverage path to improve the system — fix daily calibration, chase hourly edge, ship model-skill Stage3, or something else? Be concrete and ordered.
